lines.text: We have a lunch set today. It is twelve dollars for a sandwich and soup.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Does that include a drink, or do I need to pay for a drink separately?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: A cup of tea is included. Coffee costs two dollars more.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: So the lunch with coffee is fourteen dollars in total, right?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: That is right. We also have free water by the window.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I will have the lunch with tea then. Is it hot tea?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, the tea is hot. I can bring some ice if you want cold tea.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Hot tea is fine, thank you. I will have the set as it comes.
lines.speaker: Eli
